definitions.gloss: class reshuffling; reassigning students to new classes
definitions.explanation: the practice of reorganizing students into different homeroom classes, typically done at the beginning of a new school year

examples.japanese: クラス{替|が}え⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{離|はな}れた→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧。
examples.english: I was separated from my friends after the class reshuffling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新学年|しんがくねん}→新学年：21402_shingakunen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧クラス{替|が}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。
examples.english: I'm looking forward to the class change in the new school year.

examples.japanese: クラス{替|が}え⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なれ→なる：01970_naru⟧た。
examples.english: After the class reshuffling, I ended up in the same class as my crush.

notes:
USAGE:
Most schools reshuffle homeroom classes at the start of the school year in April, some every year and some every two years. Because students spend the whole year with the same class, the announcement is a big moment for them.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{席替|せきが}え→席替え：29987_sekigae⟧: changing seats within one class
- {組替|くみが}え: an older word for the same reshuffling
